If upstream is newer: run `scripts/update-pkgbuild.sh` (real\n   checksums from real artifacts, never SKIP), regenerate `.SRCINFO`\n   via `makepkg --printsrcinfo`, verify (`verify-package.sh`,\n   `check-consistency.sh`), update `docs/packages/<pkg>.md`, and open\n   a PR via safe-outputs. Record the probe outcome (versions seen, updated or current) in\n   memory and in the `docs/STATE.md` heartbeat.\n\n## Memory\nSchema version 1, 7 fields: version, cursors, issues, fixes, checks, completed_actions, priorities.
